goal.objective: Reconstruct the ended G20 worker lifecycle from durable evidence without reviving its claim or inheriting parent execution authority.
success_predicates: Prior lifecycle is reconstructed from durable checkpoint and Master Records evidence
Old worker instance authority remains ended
Any parent-task successor acquisition uses a separately authorized higher fencing generation
failure_predicates: Missing response is treated as a second heartbeat clock
Old claim or fence is reused
Recovery executor performs parent inference work

task.derivation_reason: Operational continuity reconstruction after the expected worker-response threshold was exceeded; this recovery task is deliberately not an authority-bearing goal successor.

activation.recheck_trigger: each canonical heartbeat after the recovery-only authorization is durable

completion.next_authorized_action: The recovery-only executor validates the ended HB25/G20 lifecycle against locally materialized canonical Master Records custody and writes only the recovery receipt. PASS completes recovery; the parent may then independently re-enter HANDOFF_READY and acquire a new fence greater than 20.
terminal_when: Reconstruction receipt is durable and Master Records evidence is bound
Old claim and fence remain unusable
Recovery task reaches COMPLETED without granting parent execution authority

block.recheck_trigger: each canonical heartbeat; release only when the bounded recovery authorization validates
block.escalation_condition: authorization drifts, old authority appears live, or recovery scope expands
